name: No Wave
summary: No Wave was a short lived underground avant-grade anti-art movement and music scene.
description: No Wave was a short lived underground avant-grade anti-art movement and music scene. It began around the late 70s in downtown Manhattan, primarily as an reaction to New Wave and the state of New York City at the time. It fizzled out in early 80s, although later groups carried on the legacy after the original scene by adopting the aesthetic and a similar approach to music. The term was coined during the creation of the split album " No New York ." [ 1 ]
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Nihilism, anti-consumerism, anti-corporatism
